cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PY'
import json,random,time
r=random.Random(1)
nf=6
schema=[{"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"} for i in range(nf)]
K=8
atoms=[]
for _ in range(20):
    a=r.randrange(nf)
    if r.random()<0.4:
        lo=r.randrange(K); hi=r.randint(lo,K-1)
        atoms.append({"quantifier":r.choice(["any","all"]),"from":lo,"to":hi,"predicate":{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f%d"%a,"at":"$"},"right":{"const":r.choice([True,False]),"type":"FLAG"}}})
    else:
        atoms.append({"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f%d"%a,"at":r.randrange(K)},"right":{"const":r.choice([True,False]),"type":"FLAG"}})
def mk(n,rows_each,prefix):
    arr=[]
    for i in range(n):
        ts=r.sample(range(2000),rows_each)
        ts.sort()
        rows=[{"t":ts[j],"values":[r.choice([True,False]) for _ in range(nf)]} for j in range(rows_each)]
        arr.append({"id":prefix+str(i),"source":r.choice(["s1","s2","s3"]),"rows":rows})
    return arr
d={"version":1,"schema":schema,"window":K,"atoms":atoms,
   "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
   "train":mk(8,512,"tr"),"probes":mk(1,135,"pr"),"queries":mk(2,520,"qu")}
# probes contexts =125<=128, queries 2*(520-7)=1026>1024 -> reduce
d["queries"]=mk(2,519,"qu")
s=json.dumps(d)
open('/app/tmp/big.json','w').write(s)
print('bytes',len(s))
PY
time ./run.sh < /app/tmp/big.json > /app/tmp/big.out; echo exit=$?; wc -c /app/tmp/big.out; head -c 200 /app/tmp/big.out; echo
